description: A spectrum analyzer built on a radix-2 FFT. Generated test signals or the microphone are analyzed frame by frame with a selectable FFT size and window function, and shown as a linear magnitude, dB or phase spectrum with peak markers, a cursor readout and an optional scrolling spectrogram.

educational.topic: FFT-based spectral analysis: bin spacing, amplitude scaling, windows and spectrograms
learningObjectives: Compute the bin spacing and frame length of an FFT from the sampling rate and the FFT size
Use the relation |X[k]| = A N / 2 to read the amplitude of a tone from an FFT
Compare the leakage of rectangular, Hamming, Hanning, Blackman and Kaiser windows
Explain the trade-off between frequency resolution and time resolution when the FFT size changes

controls.label: Move the mouse over the spectrum for a cursor readout of bin, frequency, magnitude and phase

equations: X[k] = sum over n of x[n] w[n] e^(-j 2 pi k n / N)
bin spacing = fs / N, frame length = N / fs
bin-centred sine of amplitude A: |X[k]| = A N / 2 (rectangular window)
Hanning: w[n] = 0.5 - 0.5 cos(2 pi n / N); Hamming: w[n] = 0.54 - 0.46 cos(2 pi n / N)
Blackman: w[n] = 0.42 - 0.5 cos(2 pi n / N) + 0.08 cos(4 pi n / N)
assumptions: Generated signals are sampled at 8000 Hz; square and sawtooth waves are built from their harmonics below 4000 Hz
Peak frequencies are refined by a parabola through the dB values of three bins and are approximate
The microphone is read through a Web Audio AnalyserNode at the sound card's sampling rate

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Measure known test signals first, then apply the same analyzer to live audio
keyQuestions: What sets the spacing of the frequency bins?
Why does a tone between two bins read a lower amplitude and spread into other bins?
What do you give up when you make the FFT longer?
commonMisconceptions: The height of an FFT peak is the amplitude of the tone without any scaling
A longer FFT always gives a better picture of the signal
Leakage is an error in the FFT algorithm
assessmentOpportunities: Verify |X[k]| = N / 2 for a unit sine at every FFT size
Compare the amplitude read for a 1004 Hz tone with each window at N = 1024
